title: Rebuilding the NYU Endowment – Michelle Knudsen (EP.513)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Michelle Knudsen is Chief Investment Officer of NYU, where she oversees the university's $8 billion endowment.
reader_summary.overview: Michelle Knudsen is Chief Investment Officer of NYU, where she oversees the university's $8 billion endowment. Michelle joined NYU two years ago, after fourteen years as an allocator at Partners Capital and the Mellon Foundation. Our conversation traces Michelle's lessons learned working at Goldman Sachs, a growing OCIO, and a foundation that shaped her investment philosophy and views on portfolio construction.

key_points.text: Michelle joined NYU two years ago, after fourteen years as an allocator at Partners Capital and the Mellon Foundation.
Our conversation traces Michelle's lessons learned working at Goldman Sachs, a growing OCIO.
We then turn to the transformation of NYU's investment office from the ground up across governance, portfolio strategy, investment process, and the team.
